versions.changelog:
- No changes detected in this release; version bumped without file modifications.
- All SKILL.md content and related files remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Removed two files: scripts/package.json and scripts/sign-transaction.js.
- Project scripts related to packaging and transaction signing are no longer included in this version.

Bags v1.0.0 initial release:

- Solana launchpad for humans and AI agents: authenticate, manage wallets, claim fees, trade, and launch tokens.
- Launch tokens and share fees with AI agents, collaborators, or any user.
- Detailed REST API: endpoints for authentication, wallet management, trading, fee claiming, and token launches.
- Fee sharing configurable across agents and humans, supporting multiple identity providers (Moltbook, Twitter, GitHub).
- Easy setup guides and local installation instructions provided in documentation.
